description: Source code for MachIPC class and related classes handling Mach messaging and port management on macOS, part of Google Breakpad's crash reporting system.

classes.name: MachSendMessage
classes.description: Represents a Mach IPC message for sending data.

classes.name: MachMessage
classes.description: Base class for Mach IPC messages, handling size calculation and data management.

classes.name: ReceivePort
classes.description: Encapsulates a Mach port for receiving messages, including creation and waiting for messages.

classes.name: MachPortSender
classes.description: Handles sending Mach messages to a specified port.

methods.name: MachSendMessage::MachSendMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MachSendMessage with a message ID.

methods.name: MachMessage::SetData
methods.description: Sets data payload for the message, ensuring size constraints.

methods.name: MachMessage::CalculateSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of the Mach message including headers, data, and descriptors.

methods.name: MachMessage::GetDataPacket
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to the data packet within the message.

methods.name: MachMessage::SetDescriptor
methods.description: Sets a descriptor at a specified index.

methods.name: MachMessage::AddDescriptor
methods.description: Adds a descriptor to the message if space permits.

methods.name: MachMessage::SetDescriptorCount
methods.description: Sets the number of descriptors in the message.

methods.name: MachMessage::GetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor at a specified index.

methods.name: MachMessage::GetTranslatedPort
methods.description: Gets the Mach port from a descriptor.

methods.name: ReceivePort::ReceivePort
methods.description: Creates a receive port with optional name registration.

methods.name: ReceivePort::WaitForMessage
methods.description: Waits for a message on the port with optional timeout.

methods.name: MachPortSender::MachPortSender
methods.description: Creates a sender object using a port name.

methods.name: MachPortSender::MachPortSender
methods.description: Creates a sender object with an existing Mach port.

methods.name: MachPortSender::SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a Mach message with a specified timeout.
